snippet.title: Find Your Words - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
From the award winning studio behind Grindstone and Below, a new short adventure game - Find Your Words.

Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends.

Find Your Words will come to Steam first in 2026. Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971960/Find_Your_Words/

This cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.
